name: lab
description: A squad of subagents for AI/ML research: literature surveys, paper reading, experiments with a run ledger, write-ups and retros. English by default; also Vietnamese, Chinese, French and Japanese.

language.title: Workspace language
language.description: Default language of notes, cards, plans, reviews and reports: en (English), vi (Tiếng Việt), zh (中文), fr (Français) or ja (日本語). A project can override it with `language:` in research/PROJECT.md.
